test_objectives: Validate hover-triggered UI behavior on the Hovers feature -- caption reveal/hide per avatar and "View profile" link navigation -- end-to-end via automated regression coverage.
key_findings: 21 of 24 test cases passed (87.5% success rate). All hover-triggered caption show/hide behavior passed across all three avatars. The 3 failures (TC-HOVERS-013, 014, 015) all trace to a single defect (BUG-001): clicking "View profile" navigates to /users/[1-3] as expected, but the resulting page's title is empty instead of "The Internet", so the toHaveTitle assertion times out after 10 seconds.
recommendations: Investigate why /users/[1-3] renders with an empty page title -- likely a template or routing issue on that specific page rather than the Hovers page itself, since navigation succeeds and only the title assertion fails. Re-run TC-HOVERS-013/014/015 once fixed to confirm resolution; no other action needed given every other test case passed cleanly.
conclusion: The Hovers feature's core hover interaction is solid across all three avatars, but the "View profile" navigation path has a real, reproducible defect blocking full sign-off.
